Cody Wong Hong-yi ( Chinese : 王康怡 ; born 14 March 2002) is a Hong Kong tennis player. Her brother Jack Wong is also a professional tennis player. Wong has a career-high singles ranking by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) of 319, achieved on 26 June 2023, and a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 156, attained on 17 October 2022. She has won four singles and 24 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . In 2020, Wong reached the quarterfinals in Australian Open girls' singles , which was the best ever result of Hong Kong players in Australian Open juniors, and the first Hong Kong player to reach singles quarterfinals of a major event since Patricia Hy-Boulais in 1983.
